decks.notes: This deck focuses on creating a combo with Amalia Benavides Aguirre and Aetherflux Reservoir to gain a massive amount of life and then use it to deal damage to the opponent. The deck includes cards like Collected Company and Chord of Calling to search for key combo pieces, as well as creatures like Wildgrowth Walker and Prosperous Innkeeper to gain life. The inclusion of Fiend Artisan provides additional utility and flexibility in finding necessary cards. Overall, the deck aims to assemble the combo efficiently and protect it from disruption to secure victory.

This UW Control deck focuses on using a variety of counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage engines to control the game and outvalue the opponent. The inclusion of Yorion as a companion allows for a larger starting hand and a potent flicker effect for value. The deck also includes powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria for additional card advantage and disruption. The mana base is built to support the control game plan with a mix of utility lands and dual lands to ensure consistent casting of spells.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive Rakdos creatures and efficient disruption spells to maintain board control and pressure the opponent. It aims to disrupt the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Duress while deploying threats like Bloodtithe Harvester and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger. Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord helps to buff creatures and provide additional value. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push to deal with opposing threats. Overall, the key concept is to apply early pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan to secure victory.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly attacking opponents with efficient and aggressive creatures like Vein Ripper and Bloodtithe Harvester. The deck also includes powerful disruption spells like Duress and Thoughtseize to control the opponent's hand. Cards like Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse can provide additional value and pressure on the opponent. The deck aims to apply continuous pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan to secure a quick victory.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on playing low-cost creatures and spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent with damage. By utilizing cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Burning-Tree Emissary, along with powerful pump spells like Monstrous Rage and Atarka's Command, the deck aims to push through damage efficiently and aggressively. Additionally, cards like Den of the Bugbear and Ramunap Ruins provide additional reach to close out the game if needed. Overall, the deck aims to be fast and relentless in its pursuit of victory through aggressive tactics and efficient use of resources.

The deck focuses on aggressive plays and disruption, utilizing cards like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to control the board while deploying threats like Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord and Voldaren Thrillseeker to quickly pressure the opponent. Agatha's Soul Cauldron and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide additional value and card advantage. The inclusion of Tree of Perdition and Bloodtithe Harvester adds versatility and alternative win conditions. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive game plan with a mix of dual lands and utility lands to ensure consistency and maximize efficiency.

The deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with a mix of creatures and spells to disrupt the opponent's strategy. It utilizes a combination of fast creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Reckoner Bankbuster, along with disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the board. The inclusion of powerful planeswalkers like Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord and Liliana of the Veil adds versatility and additional threats to the deck. Overall, the deck aims to apply early pressure, disrupt the opponent's game plan, and finish with powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse.

The deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with a strong emphasis on efficient removal and disruption. It utilizes powerful creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Bonecrusher Giant to pressure the opponent while using cards like Fatal Push and Duress to control the board. The inclusion of cards like Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse provide additional threats and synergy within the deck. Overall, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent and maintain board advantage through a combination of aggro creatures and disruption spells in a Rakdos color scheme.

The primary focus of this deck is to utilize cards that allow for fast and efficient card draw and spell-casting in order to continually bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a consistent stream of phoenixes, backed up by disruptive spells like Spell Pierce and Lightning Axe. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra layer of flexibility and mana acceleration to the deck's strategy, while also enabling access to colors not typically seen in traditional Phoenix builds.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. By playing low-cost creatures like Burning-Tree Emissary and Monastery Swiftspear early on, combined with powerful pump spells like Atarka's Command, the deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently. Cards like Reckless Bushwhacker and Monstrous Rage help to maintain pressure on the opponent, while cards like Play with Fire and Bonecrusher Giant provide removal options when needed. The deck's strategy is to maintain a consistent stream of threats and burn spells to chip away at the opponent's life total.

The key strategy of this Gruul Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and burn spells. By utilizing cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Fireblade Charger, along with pump spells like Titan's Strength and Audacity, the deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently. Thud and Monstrous Rage provide additional ways to finish off the opponent, while cards like Mirran Banesplitter and Kumano Faces Kakkazan help maintain board presence. The mana base of lands like Stomping Ground and Karplusan Forest ensures the deck can cast its spells on curve and maintain a steady aggression.

This deck focuses on using aggressive creatures and disruption spells to apply pressure on the opponent early in the game. It combines efficient threats like Bloodtithe Harvester and Vein Ripper with disruptive spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord is used to provide additional threats and pump up the team, while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker can generate value over time. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly while disrupting their strategy to secure a quick victory.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays and removal spells to control the battlefield. It utilizes powerful cards like Bloodtithe Harvester, Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord, and Vein Ripper to pressure the opponent and maintain board presence. With a mix of low-cost creatures and removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat, this deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent and secure victory. The inclusion of cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Thoughtseize adds versatility and disruption to disrupt the opponent's strategy and secure a win.

The deck relies on using a variety of powerful multicolor cards to control the game and outvalue the opponent. By utilizing efficient removal spells, versatile threats, and cards that provide card advantage, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating incremental advantages over time. The inclusion of Niv-Mizzet Reborn as a powerful card draw engine and Bring to Light as a versatile tutor allows for flexible and powerful plays, while the companion Yorion, Sky Nomad provides additional value throughout the game. The deck's mana base is carefully crafted to support its diverse range of spells.

The deck focuses on quickly bringing out Arclight Phoenixes from the graveyard using spells like Consider, Fiery Impulse, and Lightning Axe. It also includes ways to protect these creatures with Spell Pierce and Hall of Storm Giants. The deck utilizes card draw with Treasure Cruise and Opt to quickly cycle through the deck, while also including disruptive elements like Picklock Prankster and Brazen Borrower. The goal is to swarm the board with Arclight Phoenixes and overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy.

The deck focuses on playing aggressively with Rakdos colored cards, utilizing a combination of creatures and spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It includes powerful cards like Thoughtseize for disruption, Fatal Push for removal, and various threats like Bloodtithe Harvester and Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord to apply pressure. The deck also includes a small control element with cards like Blightstep Pathway and Liliana of the Veil. Overall, the strategy is to apply early pressure, disrupt the opponent's game plan, and close out the game quickly.
